Can we get the following added to the agenda:

* :zebra: Fusaka upgrade date setting.  December 3rd is proposed date (assuming Hoodi testnet goes well).
* Deadline for EIPs to be proposed for Glamsterdam is ~~(1 week after mainnet release date set)~~ Oct 30.
* H-star name needed (ideally set before Fusaka upgrade) https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/h-star-name-for-consensus-layer-upgrade-after-glamsterdam/24298
  * **Heka + Bogotá** could be **Hektá**
  * **Helvetios + Bogotá** could be **Heltá**

in terms of glamsterdam scoping process on the CL side, i think we can take time today to look at each EIP and discuss any initial scoping considerations

then, i'd request written proposals from each CL team for their glamsterdam selection by **13 Nov** where we would make the SFI decision. given the smaller set, any written view can be something like a team blog or even just a github comment for that week's call

[Mascot needed for Glamsterdam upgrade](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008).  Suggestions appreciated.

* :owl: Shapella (Shanghai + Capella)
* :blowfish: Dencun (Cancun + Deneb)
* :giraffe: Pectra (Prague + Electra)
* :zebra: Fusaka (Fulu + Osaka)
* :question: Glamsterdam (Gloas + Amsterdam)

Drafted an informational [EIP-8066](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10646/files) to formalize the requirements for network upgrade mascots and a facilitator role (Mascot Wrestler) to select a mascot.  

Propose using EIP-8066 for the Glamsterdam upgrade mascot selection.
Propose @eviljordan as the Mascot Wrestler for facilitating the selection of the Glamsterdam upgrade mascot.

> where we would make the SFI decision

@ralexstokes should this be the CFI decision?  I understood the process that non-headliner EIPs would move to CFI (or DFI).  They would only move to SFI when being added to the spec for the next devnet.

> Scheduled for Inclusion signals that implementation and testing work are underway.

https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7723#scheduled-for-inclusion

> * **Heka + Bogotá** could be **Hektá**
> * **Helvetios + Bogotá** could be **Heltá**

maybe its just me but shorter is better, i'd prefer Heka...

I have three PFId CL EIPs I'd like to mention. Won't take long.

EDIT, only two:

EIP-8062 Add sweep withdrawal fee for 0x01 validators : https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10639
EIP-8068 Neutral effective balance design: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10652

> Propose [@EvilJordan](https://github.com/EvilJordan) as the Mascot Wrestler for facilitating the selection of the Glamsterdam upgrade mascot.

+1 you should see the sick fulu art he's done.

I would like to PFI https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10656 (Prevent using consolidations as withdrawals). This EIP is similar to one of those that are proposed by @anderselowsson, might make sense to discuss them together.

I'd like to discuss the current status of PeerDAS cell-level deltas, a potential roadmap/timeline for testing and gradual rollout, and a speculative continuation of the BPO schedule to unlock blob throughput all the way up to 72 max (or beyond) thanks to this improvement.

> I would like to PFI [ethereum/EIPs#10656](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10656) (Prevent using consolidations as withdrawals). This EIP is similar to one of those that are proposed by [@anderselowsson](https://github.com/anderselowsson), might make sense to discuss them together.

Let's go with yours on this, it's simpler. I'll withdraw mine. The only thing to consider from a UX perspective is if it might make sense to leave some margin to enable a minor ETH overflow in order to create a full 2048-ETH validator.
